answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The jade of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The ember lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dawn is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
